name: World Tower Defense [1.18.2]
desc:
A different type of "Tower Defense" experience. Defend your base against the onslaught of enemies, but be careful with your money... they can fight back. 

1.18.2 adds the Toxic Sewers remake, with a new mode and accessory! There are many other changes, too!


Designs inspired by Tower Battles. 
Some mechanics loosely inspired by Battle Cats. 
Check the update log for information. 
More information on recent updates can be found in our server. 

WTD!
None of the music in this game is created by me. 
Credit goes to where credit is due! Credits menu can be found in the game!
If you find cheaters, please report them in our server!
